Do NOT use it to decide what graphic to show, when, or how it should look (video-production-agent), to edit video (video-editing-skill), to grade color (color-grading-skill), to generate or translate subtitles (subtitle-skill), to measure or QC media (qc-skill, media-analysis-skill), or to run arbitrary ffmpeg commands or filters (it refuses them).

name: nle-bridge-skill
title: Nle Bridge Skill
description: Hand an edit to Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve and read the editor's changes back. Writes an edit plan (nle-bridge timeline JSON, video-production-agent's project IR, or an ffmpeg-skill render project) as OpenTimelineIO, FCP7 XML (Premiere) and CMX 3600 EDL with captions as an SRT sidecar, at exact frame rates (23.976, 25, 29.97 / 59.94 drop-frame and non-drop); adds bar and beat markers from a music beat grid; builds a conform package (timelines, relink manifest with paths, sha256, timecode, size and fps, optional media copy, zip); and compares the timeline the NLE exports back with the plan - cuts moved by how many frames, clips trimmed / added / removed, markers changed, and how far each cut is off the beat. Says, item by item, what a format cannot carry (effects, speed changes, titles, transitions) instead of dropping it. Use when asked to export a timeline or XML / EDL / OTIO for Premiere or Resolve, send a cut to an editor, make a conform or relink package, put beat markers on a timeline, or find what the editor changed. Files only, no live NLE control; local, no network.

name: publish-skill

description: Upload a finished, QC-passed deliverable to a delivery platform (YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Facebook or Instagram Reels), and check it and its title, description, tags, privacy, thumbnail and captions against the platform's upload limits offline first. Use when asked to publish, upload or post a finished video to a platform, to check whether a video and its metadata will be accepted, or to check whether publishing is set up. Dry run by default; an upload needs the confirmation token the dry run printed for exactly that file, metadata and platform, and a human's approval. Credentials come from environment variables or the OS keychain (`publish auth login`) and are never printed. YouTube uploads use the Data API v3 resumable upload, Vimeo uploads the tus resumable upload TikTok uploads the Content Posting API's Direct Post in chunks X uploads the X API v2 chunked media upload and then one public post, LinkedIn uploads the Videos API multipart upload and then one public post, Facebook uploads the Resumable Upload API and then publishes one Page video, and Instagram Reels uploads to a resumable REELS container and then publishes one reel; all seven retry interrupted uploads.
